scope: Stage 4B only; excludes 4C and downstream scoring

rules.cas_identity: All member CAS aliases, checksum-valid, sorted; worst mapping status across aliases; canonical full identities unchanged
rules.litchemplast_match: Exact full InChIKey first; CAS fallback only for source rows without a valid full key and an unambiguous target with one candidate
rules.litchemplast_count: Unique LitChem_id and unique Lit_id separately; require the frozen relationship sheet; no silent declared-count fallback
rules.fcchumon_match: One-to-one target CAS and exactly one sheet/CAS candidate; reject multiple candidates including cross-sheet matches
rules.fcchumon_count: Maximum within each source sheet/CAS group; do not sum across sheets
rules.reader: Historical pandas type inference and default NA tokens; UTF-8 exports; source files remain unchanged
rules.counts: Historical coercion of missing/non-numeric values to zero and integer truncation retained with raw-value conversion audit; negative counts fail
rules.availability: Unmatched or rejected evidence is unavailable, not negative; legacy zero/False retained only with explicit resolution status
rules.identity_review: QSAR and Pov/LRTP isolation inherited unchanged; independent source evidence uses Stage 2 identities and separate source matching rules
